subject: A tall rectangular arcade cabinet roughly twice as tall as it is wide and about one and a half times as deep as it is wide, standing on a flat black base plinth; the main body is matte black with a dark blue marquee panel at the top bearing a glowing cyan title strip, a slightly recessed control panel at chest height with a red joystick ball on the left and two round buttons on the right, the outer button yellow and the inner button red, a black bezel surrounding a dark grey screen below the marquee, and simple black side panels with a thin magenta stripe running along their outer edge.

views.front: Show the front face of the cabinet straight on: the black base plinth at the bottom spanning the full width, the dark blue marquee with cyan title strip across the top, the dark grey screen inside its black bezel in the upper-middle, and the control panel with the red joystick ball on the left and the yellow button left of the red button on the right. The cabinet's overall width and height here set the reference size for all other views; the magenta side stripes must NOT be visible, and no perspective, no shadow, no ground.
views.side: Show the left side panel straight on: a tall matte black rectangle standing on the black base plinth, with the thin magenta stripe running vertically along the front edge of the panel, and the control panel visible only as a slight protrusion at the top edge in the upper-middle of the silhouette. The height must exactly match the front view's height including the plinth, and the depth (width of this view) must match the top view's depth. The screen, marquee, joystick and buttons must NOT be visible.
views.back: Show the rear face straight on: a plain matte black rectangle standing on the black base plinth, with a small dark grey rectangular vent panel low on the left side and a thin dark grey cable-exit slot at the bottom right. The width must exactly match the front view's width and the height must match the front view. The marquee, screen, controls, buttons and magenta stripe must NOT be visible.
views.top: Show the cabinet viewed from directly above: a single matte black rectangle whose width exactly matches the front view's width and whose depth exactly matches the side view's depth, with the dark blue marquee strip running along the front edge, the control panel appearing as a shallow dark grey band just behind the marquee with the red joystick ball and yellow and red buttons visible as small circles on it, and the black bezel and dark grey screen as a rectangle behind that. The base plinth must form the outer boundary of the rectangle. The magenta side stripes must NOT appear, and no shadow or ground may be shown.
